meta.notes: Weapon attack, scaling letters, and requirements are the standard-affinity or unique-weapon rows from the mandude ERR 2.3.5.3 calculator (MIT). Scaling letters use the second scalingTiers table in that file, which is the table that matches the ERR wiki letters: S at 2.25 or higher, A at 1.89, B at 1.44, C at 0.99, D at 0.54, and E at 0.22. Plus and minus steps between those floors are folded into the letter, so A+ and A- are stored as A, and the same for B, C, and D. S+ is stored as S. Values below E, including the calculator's F grade, are omitted. The vanilla regulation tiers (S at 1.75, A at 1.4, B at 0.9, C at 0.6, D at 0.25, E at 0.01) match this site's vanilla equipment letters and were not used, because they disagree with ERR's numbers and with the wiki letters. Affinities modify a weapon's scaling instead of replacing it. The numbers shown are standard affinity (affinity id 0) or the weapon's only row (affinity id -1). The 24 affinity names in the calculator are Standard, Heavy, Keen, Quality, Fire, Fell, Lightning, Sacred, Magic, Cold, Poison, Bloody, Occult, Bolt, Soporific, Frenzied, Magma, Rotten, Cursed, Night, Gravitational, Blessed, Bestial, and Fated. Renames applied where the calculator name is the plural or the spelling of a vanilla name that is absent: Backhand Blade to Backhand Blades, Starscourge Greatsword to Starscourge Greatswords, Greatsword of Radahn (Light) and Greatsword of Radahn (Lord) to one entry named Greatswords of Radahn, Zweihander to Zweihänder, Curseblade's Cirque to Curseblade's Cirques, Dancing Blade of Ranah to Dancing Blades of Ranah, Horned Warrior's Sword to Horned Warrior's Swords, Ornamental Straight Sword to Ornamental Straight Swords, and Smithscript Cirque to Smithscript Cirques. Brass Dagger is not recorded as the renamed Erdsteel Dagger. That pairing is unconfirmed, and so are Dragon Halberd / Dragonscale Halberd, Rotten Greataxe / Rotten Duelist Greataxe, Spiked Spear / Marionette Spiked Spear, Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle / Poison Perfume Bottle, Carian Glintstone Staff / Dark Glintstone Staff, and a replacement for Moonrithyll's Knight Sword. The wiki page Nox Flowing Fist is the calculator weapon Nox Flowing Fists. Stoneshield Claws is not in the 2.3.5.3 calculator. Its page was parsed from the ERR wiki and broken template fields were left out. Armor sets are the vanilla list. Vanilla data, ERR passive effects not yet added. The calculator's crit field is not the wiki crit rating (a longsword is 0 and the Blasphemous Blade is -5), so crit is left out. No 2.3.8.1 numbers were available. Sources: mandude weapon calculator (MIT) https://mandude.github.io/elden-ring-weapon-calculator/ and the regulation file regulation-reforged-v2.3.5.3 (MIT), tclark calculator (MIT, Reforged 2.3.3.0, credited and not used for these numbers) https://eldenring.tclark.io/reforged , ERR wiki on Fandom (CC BY-SA) https://err.fandom.com/wiki/ELDEN_RING_Reforged_Wiki .

armorSets.name: Ansbach's Set
armorSets.description: Ansbach's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. It is an Armor Set introduced in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor. This armor set offers very high overall stats, ideal for lightweight builds.
armorSets.notes: Vanilla data, ERR passive effects not yet added.
armorSets.location: (Shadow of the Erdtree) Complete Sir Ansbach's questline all the way through the end, and side with him when facing Leda, and then Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella. After the fight is over, Sir Ansbach's body will be near the site of grace, alongside his equipment and his Incantation. Map Link. Though it locks you out of Obsidian Lamina and Furious Blade of Ansbach, the armor can be obtained earlier by siding with Leda, in addition to her rewards.

armorSets.name: Azur's Glintstone Set
armorSets.description: Azur's Glintstone Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are usually composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.

armorSets.location: All three armor pieces can be found after completing Sorceress Sellen's Questline and siding with her towards the end, return to Primeval Sorcerer Azur's location. The full set will be where the Sorcerer used to be located.

armorSets.name: Blaidd's Set
armorSets.description: Blaidd's Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. Blaidd's Set is comprised of the three pieces of armor he can be seen wearing, as well as a replica mask of his head that can be found separate from the other three pieces. Sets of Armor in Elden Ring are composed of four armor pieces which are Helms, Chest Armor, Gauntlets, and Leg Armor.

armorSets.location: The three main pieces of Blaidd's Set, Blaidd's Armor, Blaidd's Gauntlets, and Blaidd's Greaves, can be found by following Ranni's questline. After she is given the Dark Moon Ring, return to Ranni's Rise and you will hear Blaidd talking to himself in front of the tower. When he finishes his dialogue he will turn hostile, and defeating him will grant the player Blaidd's Armor, Blaidd's Gauntlets, and Blaidd's Greaves (as well as the Royal Greatsword). The helmet, Black Wolf Mask, can be found separately nearby to where the first three pieces are obtained. The mask can be found on a corpse on the wall behind Seluvis's Rise.

armorSets.location: The entire Tree Sentinel Set can be found in the following location: Obtained inside the Auriza Hero's Grave. Elden Ring Map Link Acquiring the set requires you to destroy three specific Chariots. Doing this involves quite a few steps: From this first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps, and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path and you will end up in a large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. These are the Chariots you need to destroy.

armorSets.name: White Mask
armorSets.description: White Mask is a Helm in Elden Ring. White Mask is part of the War Surgeon Set, and is a lightweight helm that strikes a good balance between Physical and Magical defense. White Mask protect the player's head by applying various defensive properties, it also changes the appearance when it is equipped. Some armor pieces may be available to both genders but may be slightly different for male and female characters. There is a lock-out condition for the acquisition of this item.

armorSets.name: White Reed Set
armorSets.description: White Reed Set is an Armor Set in Elden Ring. White Reed Set is also known as the Armor of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inaba, head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothing more than to die by the sword.
